about.text:
Chengdu Pedex Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2021 in Chengdu, Sichuan, China — the beautiful “Land of Abundance.” We serve customers across domestic and international markets, with an overseas presence spanning Europe, the United States, the Middle East, and North Africa.

Our business brings together two specialized divisions: optical communications and industrial flow control.

Optical Connectivity, from the Device to the Network

Our optical communications division covers a broad range of connectivity products, including optical transceivers, optical components, fiber optics, patch cords, connectors, active optical cables (AOCs), and fiber optic cables.

We work with telecom operators, data center integrators, system integrators, and regional distributors to meet a wide range of technical and commercial requirements. Whether you need standard products, customized solutions, or a sourcing partner who understands the details, we focus on making your supply chain work better.

Industrial Flow Control, Built for the Job

Through our subsidiary, we manufacture industrial valves, including gate valves, ball valves, and butterfly valves, serving diverse industrial applications.

Different industries, different products — but the same approach: practical solutions, dependable quality, and service that puts the customer first.

Flexible by Design. Practical by Nature.

At Pedex, we understand that business doesn't always come in one size. Some customers need high-volume supply; others need smaller quantities, special specifications, or a tailored solution.

Big orders are welcome. Small orders are welcome, too. We believe a good partnership should be based on what you need, not just how many units you buy.

From standard products to customized requirements, we aim to offer flexible service, competitive value, and a straightforward way of doing business.

Pedex — Different industries. Connected by one commitment: making business easier for our customers.
